split.calibration_role: Model/implementation diagnostic only; cannot change any threshold, parameter, case, or heldout seed.

registered_plan.candidate_selection: Exactly one clean 5-epoch CILS call per seed; best/second and active labels frozen before future validation.
registered_plan.future_validation: Five strictly later epochs; frozen N; separate 3D b_k each epoch. Never choose a replacement candidate, extend the horizon, or re-search integers from future outcomes.

admission_policy.residual_gate: Sum free-baseline GLS residual cost versus chi-square(sum(n_k-3)).
admission_policy.length_gate: Sum sphere projection penalties versus chi-square(3K); each penalty bounded by true-baseline Gaussian Mahalanobis distance.
admission_policy.conditions: Known Gaussian working Q and correctly specified mean; alpha is not false-fix probability.
admission_policy.threshold_adjustment: Forbidden on both calibration and heldout.
admission_policy.meaning: SHADOW_ACCEPTED is experimental gate output, not production integer FIX or calibrated integrity.

models.phase_sigma_provenance: Fixed engineering 4 mm, NOT receiver RAWX 0.004 cycles floor.
models.working_Q: Exact generated within-epoch DD covariance, including shared pivot and GPS cross-frequency terms; solver assumes independent epochs.
models.motion: 18..54 deg continuous yaw rotation and sinusoidal 7 deg tilt over 1.8 s; independent b_k in solver.
models.integers: Fixed known per-group [2,-1,4] (+3 per later group); M4 [2,-1,4,0].
models.fault_timing: All perturbations start at epoch index 5, after candidate selection. First five matrices/observations shared bitwise across conditions.
models.pivot_fault: RX2 pivot +0.25 cycles => every phase DD of that signal group shifts -0.25 lambda.
models.slip: Target RX2 +1 cycle from epoch index 5 without arc reset: no constant N can represent the entire selection+validation window.
models.temporal_rho08: Only future segment follows AR(1), seeded by last selection-epoch latent noise; marginal Q unchanged, cross-epoch dependence unmodeled.
models.insufficient_support: Only two target code/phase rows retained; known phase count=2, must remain unresolved.
models.two_faults: Two different RX2 target signals have +0.25 and -0.40 cycles; retain single-fault-model mismatch.

separation.selection_inputs: First five blocks only; no truth or future file is passed to CILS worker.
separation.validation_inputs: Frozen best/second and five future blocks; truth is separate and opened only for final outcome labeling.

outcomes: baseline angle error even when integer-correct
reporting.accuracy_units: Per-condition independent seed denominator: 48 heldout total, 16 per layer; never pool 336 paired heldout conditions as IID.
reporting.intervals: Wilson interval per condition (and per layer) for observed shadow wrong-acceptance proportion; observed wrong acceptance is not a calibrated future integrity guarantee.
